coordinate_frame: supersplat-original +Y up; relative units, not surveyed meters

speed_policy.units: native, not certified metres; pauses have no finite upper bound

provenance.method: Existing CollisionWorld walkability; calibrated FOV and conservative opaque AABB rays at generic heights; no actor/evaluator inputs

limitations: Native units and generic assumed body height1.65 are not surveyed physical measurements
Opaque AABBs are conservative; glazing/foliage and partial silhouettes remain uncertain
Visibility is an approximate static sensor prior, never a person observation
Door states are named assumptions, not live observations
Speed policy is configurable and uncalibrated; no arbitrary maximum pause duration
